races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lisnamurrican
runners_data.note: Class act returning from 91-day break for champion trainer, but needs to prove fitness first time back

runners_data.name: That Is Blue
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner well-suited to conditions, trainer in poor form but mare has shown level form

runners_data.name: Strong Run
runners_data.note: Versatile performer carrying extra weight but boasts excellent record on similar going with 2 wins from 8 soft ground starts

runners_data.name: Grey Gamble
runners_data.note: Front runner returning after 155-day absence, booking of Ben Jones suggests connections expect bold show

runners_data.name: Madmoiselle Moss
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who typically fades late, long break and trainer's poor strike rate are concerns

runners_data.name: Pink Perjury
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with tendency to weaken in finish, needs strong pace to set up her style but may lack finishing kick

runners_data.name: Precious Jean
runners_data.note: Well out of her depth at this level with 5lb claimer aboard, likely to be tailed off early

races.paceDynamic: Lisnamurrican and Grey Gamble will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to go forward from the start. That Is Blue and Strong Run should track them prominently, creating an honest gallop over this staying trip on testing ground. The prolonged battle up front will set up a strong pace that should favour horses with proven stamina reserves. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is honest but not suicidal with leaders lasting longer than expected
scenarios.body: Strong Run and That Is Blue can use their prominent style to track the pace and kick clear when gaps appear. Their connections to stamina-testing conditions gives them the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders can establish a decisive advantage and maintain it
scenarios.body: Lisnamurrican's class advantage and Henderson's training could see her dominate from the front despite the long layoff. Grey Gamble's fresh legs after 155 days could also sustain a bold bid throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the leaders collapse dramatically
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses Pink Perjury and Madmoiselle Moss could benefit from a truly-run race if they avoid their usual finishing fade. However, both have shown recent tendencies to weaken late which limits this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and burn out before the home turn
scenarios.body: This would create a messy tactical affair where any horse with some energy left could capitalize. Strong Run's versatility and That Is Blue's recent consistency make them best placed to adapt.

watchPoints.text: Precious Jean looks completely outclassed and could be pulled up if struggling badly
Grey Gamble and Lisnamurrican both returning from long breaks - watch for signs of rustiness in early stages
Strong Run carries 7lbs more than most rivals which could tell in testing conditions over this trip
Madmoiselle Moss, Pink Perjury and Precious Jean all show headgear changes suggesting recent issues
Track Lisnamurrican's jumping rhythm as any mistakes could prove costly given the break since last run

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Carrigmoorna Rowan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid form but poor trainer record and hasn't won for some time, though places consistently.

runners_data.name: Gold Clermont
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 41-day break with excellent similar going record but needs strong pace to aim at.

runners_data.name: Moonlit Potter
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from in-form yard wearing blinkers, quick turnaround from 8 days ago could be positive or negative.

runners_data.name: Ballynaheer
runners_data.note: Front-runner in excellent form with top trainer strike-rate, likely to get uncontested lead and hard to catch.

runners_data.name: Le Galli Bier
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with decent recent form but inexperienced jockey may struggle with tactical positioning.

runners_data.name: Sweet Nightingale
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good recent win but needs pace to collapse, tongue-tie suggests breathing issues.

runners_data.name: Edgewell
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent wins but trainer out of form, needs strong gallop to show finishing kick.

races.paceDynamic: Ballynaheer will likely lead from the outset given his front-running style and the lack of other confirmed pace-setters in this field. With most runners preferring prominent or hold-up tactics, he should get an uncontested lead and be able to dictate a steady gallop. The main danger will come from prominent runners like Carrigmoorna Rowan, Moonlit Potter, and Le Galli Bier tracking in behind, while the hold-up horses Gold Clermont, Sweet Nightingale, and Edgewell will need the pace to collapse late. This sustainable pace scenario heavily favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without being pressured early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ballynaheer Wire To Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer gets an easy lead and maintains his recent winning form
scenarios.body: He can control the tempo completely and kick clear approaching the final fence when the hold-up horses still have too much ground to make up. His excellent recent record and lack of early pressure makes him very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can sit handy and outstay Ballynaheer
scenarios.body: Carrigmoorna Rowan or Le Galli Bier can track the leader before challenging late, benefiting from race fitness and tactical positioning. The longer trip may find out Ballynaheer's stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably fast or Ballynaheer stops quickly
scenarios.body: Gold Clermont or Sweet Nightingale can use their finishing kicks to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Both have winning form when getting the right race setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ballynaheer goes too slow early then quickens dramatically
scenarios.body: This creates a sprint finish where hold-up horses like Edgewell can use his recent good form to get up late. The race becomes a dash from the last fence.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Ballynaheer gets headed early as he may not respond well to pressure having had things his own way recently.
Watch Gold Clermont's jumping early as he's returning from a 41-day break and needs to stay handy enough.
Watch the pace through halfway as if it's too steady the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground.
Watch Moonlit Potter's stamina over this longer trip as his recent form has been over shorter distances.
Watch Le Galli Bier's positioning as inexperienced jockey may get too far back from this prominent runner.

races.name: KSR Lighting Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Precious Metal
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 48-day break to soft ground where she excels, with Henrietta Knight's yard in good form lately.

runners_data.name: He's A Latchico
runners_data.note: Patient closer who needs the race to develop into a sprint, though the Moore stable is currently struggling with runners.

runners_data.name: Calvino
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning fresh after 57 days for Paul Nicholls, will control the race from the front but needs to sustain his effort.

runners_data.name: Valadon
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has been consistent lately, wearing a tongue-tie and represents the in-form Harry Fry stable.

runners_data.name: Yellow Star
runners_data.note: Inconsistent prominent runner carrying top weight with a pull-up last time raising fitness concerns.

runners_data.name: Jackomy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent recent form with two wins, ideally suited to a strongly-run contest over this staying trip.

races.paceDynamic: Calvino will set an uncontested lead from the start, with Valadon and Yellow Star settling in prominent positions behind him. The lack of other genuine pace angles means Calvino can dictate terms throughout the 2m5½f trip without serious pressure until the business end. This controlled gallop will see the field bunched turning for home, setting up a sprint finish where the hold-up horses Precious Metal, He's A Latchico and Jackomy can unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the closers who can benefit from the solid pace and finish fastest when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closer's Paradise
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino sets steady fractions and the field stays bunched until the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy before unleashing late runs, with Precious Metal and Jackomy ideally positioned to strike. Fresh legs triumph over early pace-setters who've done too much work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino maintains his lead and the prominent horses fail to mount serious challenges
scenarios.body: Calvino's class tells as he kicks clear approaching the last hurdle, with his 57-day break providing the freshness to sustain his effort. The Paul Nicholls-trained runner proves too strong for the late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Valadon and Yellow Star press Calvino throughout and create a genuine pace duel
scenarios.body: The early pace burns out the front three, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past in the final furlong. He's A Latchico benefits most from his tactical position and recent race fitness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Calvino goes too slow and the field clusters together from halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the second-last hurdle, favouring horses with natural pace rather than stamina. Yellow Star's class and finishing speed could prove decisive in a cavalry charge finish.

watchPoints.text: Yellow Star pulled up last time at Exeter and carries top weight, making her fitness a major concern despite her class.
Calvino making his comeback after 57 days with conditional jockey Paddy Hanlon taking the 5lb claim in this competitive field.
The Moore stable (He's A Latchico, Yellow Star) running poorly this season with just 1 winner from 43 recent runners.
Precious Metal returning to her favoured soft ground conditions where she has won twice from eight attempts.
Jackomy arrives in career-best form with back-to-back victories and suits the likely strong pace scenario perfectly.

races.name: V2 Radio Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: West Orchard
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form who will track Has Troke closely and has proven stamina for this trip on similar going.

runners_data.name: Has Troke
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner returning from a 66-day break but has excellent record on soft ground and will dictate terms.

runners_data.name: Amalfi Skyline
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying low weight with a class edge but needs luck in running from the back of the field.

runners_data.name: Fravanco
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from a 32-day break who could benefit from tracking the leaders without setting the pace.

runners_data.name: Counteract
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 881 days off, making him a complete unknown quantity despite trainer Chris Gordon's recent form.

runners_data.name: Shesupincourt
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent course experience who wore a tongue-tie last time and could improve for the headgear.

runners_data.name: Simon The Seagull
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with a 3-pound claiming jockey who has shown form on soft ground but needs to be produced at the right time.

runners_data.name: Miss Jaffa Cake
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with limited form who will need significant improvement to feature in this company.

runners_data.name: Approaching Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with a tendency to fade in the finish, making her vulnerable over this extended trip despite recent fair form.

races.paceDynamic: Has Troke will lead from the start with West Orchard tracking close behind, creating a moderate early gallop over this staying trip. The confirmed front-runner Has Troke won't face serious early pressure, allowing him to dictate terms through the middle stages. With five hold-up horses (Amalfi Skyline, Counteract, Simon The Seagull, Miss Jaffa Cake, Approaching Storm) all needing to be produced late, the pace will be honest but not punishing early before quickening from three out. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to the pace and avoid traffic problems that could plague the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Has Troke and West Orchard establish a clear lead and maintain their advantage through solid jumping.
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will have every chance to see out the trip on this good ground, with Has Troke's proven stamina and West Orchard's excellent recent form giving them first run on the field. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up significant ground in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong or the leaders tire approaching the final flight.
scenarios.body: A strong-travelling hold-up horse will benefit from the honest gallop and superior finishing kick to collar the prominent runners in the final 100 yards. Amalfi Skyline's class edge could prove decisive despite his low weight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Fravanco or Shesupincourt can secure ideal positions tracking the leaders without getting involved in early pace battles.
scenarios.body: These prominent runners will get perfect trips behind the front two and have enough left to mount sustained challenges from two out. Their tactical positioning gives them the best of both worlds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Has Troke goes too fast early or makes jumping errors, disrupting the rhythm and creating a scramble.
scenarios.body: The race will become a lottery with multiple horses still in contention at the last, favouring those who can quicken best from unpromising positions. Traffic problems will determine the outcome more than ability.

watchPoints.text: Has Troke jumping fluently in the early stages will be crucial as any mistakes could disrupt the entire race rhythm.
Traffic problems developing from three flights out as five hold-up horses all need room to challenge simultaneously.
West Orchard's jumping and positioning behind Has Troke through the back straight will indicate his winning chance.
Amalfi Skyline getting a clear run from the final flight as his class advantage only matters if he avoids interference.
The pace through the middle section determining whether the leaders have enough left or the closers can get there in time.

races.name: A.W. Jeffreys (Southampton) Ltd Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: It's A Breeze

runners_data.name: Kitsilano
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer with strong soft ground record but needs pace to develop in his favour

runners_data.name: Hatos
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent current form who should get ideal position tracking the leader

runners_data.name: Majestic Moment
runners_data.note: Recent winner who races prominently but 17-day break may not be ideal for peak sharpness

runners_data.name: Gorcombe Moonshine
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer carrying light weight with solid recent placed efforts

runners_data.name: Ballybay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning recent form including multiple pulled-up efforts over various trips

runners_data.name: King Of The Story
runners_data.note: Long absence of 148 days is major concern despite previous winning form when fresh

runners_data.name: A Little Something
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from in-form yard who needs strong pace but has shown ability at this level

runners_data.name: Jaffa Cake
runners_data.note: Front-runner who sets the tactical tone but concerning recent form with multiple poor efforts

runners_data.name: Greenways
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from small yard carrying minimum weight but trainer struggling for winners

runners_data.name: Millies Mite
runners_data.note: Prominent performer who should get good position but trainer's poor strike-rate is concerning

runners_data.name: Fourtwofour
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade late carrying 3lb claimer after very long absence

races.paceDynamic: Jaffa Cake is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will dictate a controlled gallop without pressure early on. Behind him, prominent runners Hatos, Gorcombe Moonshine, Greenways and Millies Mite will track in second flight, while the majority of this field comprises hold-up horses who will need things to develop. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be steady rather than searching, allowing the leaders to maintain their position deep into the contest. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-running burden that may catch up with Jaffa Cake.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake sets manageable fractions without serious pace pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect scenario to track the leader and mount sustained challenges from the three-out. Those sitting in the box seat behind the pace-setter can time their efforts perfectly while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on leaders who haven't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake's controlled early lead allows him to quicken clear turning for home before challenges arrive
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure preserves his stamina reserves for a decisive move, while prominent runners find themselves outpaced by his acceleration. Hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up as the winner stretches clear in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the steady early gallop becomes a tactical crawl that sets up a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario as the pace collapses completely, allowing them to unleash finishing kicks past tiring leaders. Strong finishers can use their superior turn of foot to sweep past horses who've been waiting too long in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Jaffa Cake weakens dramatically and the prominent runners fail to capitalize, creating a muddling finish
scenarios.body: The race fragments completely with no clear pace scenario emerging, leading to an unpredictable finish where any style could prevail. Horses with tactical speed rather than pure staying power may benefit most from the stop-start nature.

watchPoints.text: Jaffa Cake could steal this completely if allowed uncontested lead given lack of other genuine pace
Watch for early positioning of Hatos and Gorcombe Moonshine as they need to avoid being shuffled back
King Of The Story's 148-day absence makes him unpredictable despite previous ability when fresh
Hold-up horses like Kitsilano need to be held up but not too far back given lack of pace
Ground conditions changing throughout card so monitor if going deteriorates further for later runners

races.name: Fontwell Park Weddings & Events Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Superstylin
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with Tom Cannon booked, ideally positioned if the pace is true but may lack finishing kick if it becomes tactical.

runners_data.name: Blue Universe
runners_data.note: Strong prominent style with solid ratings but the 78-day break and 5lb claimer Paddy Hanlon create minor concerns despite recent placed efforts.

runners_data.name: Dontaskchris
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 715 days off which is a major unknown, but the 17lb weight drop and Harry Kimber's 7lb claim make him very interesting.

runners_data.name: Spanish Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but trainer Richard Bandey is 0/7 in the last 14 days and recent form shows consistent but uninspiring mid-division finishes.

runners_data.name: Calshot Spit
runners_data.note: Handy prominent type who won at Hereford last time but that was on heavy ground and this represents a step up in class.

runners_data.name: Jefe Triunfo
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer from the in-form Chris Gordon yard who should be suited by the likely tactical nature but needs to bounce back from recent poor runs.

runners_data.name: Bread And Butter
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with solid recent form and Freddie Mitchell's 3lb claim helps, though 11 years old raises stamina sustainability questions.

runners_data.name: My Lovely Horse
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with 5lb claimer James Turner aboard, likely to get uncontested lead but low rating suggests vulnerable in finish.

runners_data.name: Hiero Sport
runners_data.note: Prominent type who has been consistent without winning, the 18lb weight drop and course experience could see him outrun odds in tactical affair.

runners_data.name: Easter Icon
runners_data.note: Handy prominent runner but 5lb claimer Isabelle Ryder and recent underwhelming efforts suggest she needs to improve significantly.

runners_data.name: Nelson Gate
runners_data.note: Four-year-old prominent runner having just his second season over hurdles, the youth factor could be crucial if this becomes a stamina test.

runners_data.name: Chosen Bae

runners_data.name: Bushstreet Bowman

races.paceDynamic: My Lovely Horse will lead from the gate with no other confirmed front-runners in this field, creating a sustainable tempo over the 2m3f trip. The prominent runners Superstylin, Blue Universe, Spanish Dancer, Calshot Spit, and Easter Icon will settle within striking distance but none will pressure the leader early. This sets up a tactical finish where the hold-up horses Dontaskchris, Jefe Triunfo, Bread And Butter, and Bushstreet Bowman can be produced late. The moderate pace and single leader scenario strongly favours closers who can stay on strongly up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If My Lovely Horse sets an uncontested lead allowing closers to close strongly
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace plays perfectly into the hands of the late-running brigade who can use their finishing kicks. Dontaskchris returns from a long break fresh while Jefe Triunfo and Bread And Butter have the class to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group maintains position and kicks clear before the closers can respond
scenarios.body: Superstylin and Blue Universe have the pace positioning and class to seize control entering the straight. Their higher ratings and tactical speed prove decisive against the hold-up horses who leave it too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If My Lovely Horse sets too slow a tempo creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test where the freshest horse wins in a blanket finish. Nelson Gate's youth and Bread And Butter's experience of these tactical affairs could prove crucial in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If My Lovely Horse maintains the lead and holds on gamely to the line
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds enough advantage to resist late challenges on the testing uphill finish. Despite the low rating, the tactical advantage and lack of early pressure creates the shock result.

watchPoints.text: Dontaskchris returning from 715 days off is the ultimate unknown quantity - could be fresh and well-handicapped or completely rusty and unfit.
My Lovely Horse getting an uncontested lead could prove more dangerous than his low rating suggests if the pace becomes truly pedestrian.
The 5lb claimers James Turner, Paddy Hanlon and Isabelle Ryder all need to handle the tactical nature and deliver well-timed challenges.
Superstylin and Blue Universe as the highest-rated prominent runners must justify favouritism by asserting when the pace lifts.
Bushstreet Bowman's recent habit of fading in the finish could resurface if this becomes a genuine staying test up the hill.
